document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Each of you with a rifle starts firing at the alien creatures. One 
of them grabs a twisted silvery device and points it at you. A 
beam strikes the rock you crouch behind!

Ice crystals form before your eyes, coating the surface of the 
rock. Fragments shatter off with a loud crack.
You hit that alien in its midriff, and it falls.

Gain 1 point of Cthulhu Mythos. Roll for rifle attacks. If you and 
Norman can hit twice more in the next four shots, you may drive 
off the other aliens before they can get to their weapons. If so, go to 
381. If not, go to 380.
